gloss: to gush out; to spurt out; to spout

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}き{出|で}ていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to gush out; to spurt out; to spout
definitions.explanation: Liquid, gas, or substance erupting outward

definitions.gloss: to break out; to appear on the surface
definitions.explanation: Sweat, pimples, rashes appearing on the skin

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}た。
examples.english: Water gushed out from the ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Steam is spouting from the pipe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{溶岩|ようがん}→溶岩：13328_yougan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}た。
examples.english: Lava gushed out from the volcano.
Sweat broke out on my forehead.
Pimples broke out on my face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Sweat broke out all over my body from nervousness.

notes:
An intransitive compound verb combining ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) + ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out). Describes something emerging forcefully from inside to outside. Used for liquids, gases, and things appearing on the skin.

TRANSITIVITY: intransitive (transitive pair: ⟦{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す→吹き出す：06342_fukidasu⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: water gushes out
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: sweat breaks out
- ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: pimples break out
- ⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}き{出|で}る: steam spouts out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す→吹き出す：06342_fukidasu⟧: to spout/burst out — the transitive counterpart; also means to burst out laughing
- ⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧: to erupt/spew — emphasizes violent eruption; also means to burst out laughing
- ⟦{溢|あふ}れる→溢れる：04250_afureru⟧: to overflow — liquid exceeding its container, without the forceful eruption nuance
